summary: Frontend-only test (Playwright, desktop + 1 mobile screenshot) of (B) the 10.2.1 typed-position move bug fix and (A) the Log Rigging Check / Log Service feature on the 6 Boat Maintenance lists. Seeded TEST user TEST_it103 (session test_session_it103) with a TEST_Outline checklist (1-10, 4>4.1>4.1.1, 5>5.1, 10>10.1,10.2>10.2.1), the 6 maint lists, a custom maint list, Rigging Checks, Ship's Log, My To Do; removed afterwards. Almost everything passes. One minor bug: if the grandparent (10) is folded, the moved item stays hidden because only the direct parent (10.2) is unfolded.

ui_bugs.issue: With both 10 and 10.2 folded, typing 10.2.1 on item 11 moved it correctly (later seen at 10.2.1, data-level 2, old 10.2.1 became 10.2.2, kept after reload), but 10 stayed folded ('Ten 4 sub-items · 0 ticked'), so the moved item was hidden. placePath only calls setFold(parent.id,false) for the direct parent. It should also unfold every ancestor: outlineInfo(items)[p.id].ancestors.forEach(a => setFold(a,false)). With only 10.2 folded it opens correctly.
The validation error (maint-service-error) stays on screen after the user fixes the field, until Save is pressed again. Minor: clear the error when a field changes.

issues: Date / Next due use the browser's native date inputs, not the shadcn calendar. This matches the rest of the app, so it's only a note.

passed_tests: Ordering toggle on; a newly added item lands at the end as 11 (top level)
Typing 10.2.1 makes it the first sub-item of 10.2 (data-level 2); the old 10.2.1 becomes 10.2.2; kept after reload
A folded 10.2 opens when an item moves into it (10 open)
Typing x.2.9 puts the item last under x.2 (7.2.4)
A branch moves with its sub-items: 5 (with 5.1) typed as 3.1 became 3.1 / 3.1.1
A plain number still reorders among siblings (8 typed as 1)
A leaf moved to 4 levels (7.2.1.1) shows data-level 3

Error toasts, nothing changes: 'no item 8.9 to go under'; 'can't go under itself' (4.1.1.1, 4.2); 'deeper than 4 levels' (branch of depth 2 to 7.2.1; branch with a child to 7.2.1.1); '4 levels deep at most' (1.1.1.1.1); 'Type a number like...' (abc)

Button text: Log Rigging Check on Running Rigging, Standing Rigging and Spars & Heavy Hardware; Log Service on Deck Hardware, Sail Loft and Ground Tackle. The dialog title, who label (Rigger's / Sailmaker's name / Serviced by), placeholders and date (today) all match
No button on a custom attribute list; no button and no per-item button for crew (test-user-free on the pro boat)
Validation: no items, no name ('Enter the rigger's name'), due equal to or before the date
Ticking a category heading ticks all its items; Save shows a count
Saving sets maint-last and maint-due on the picked items only, shows a success toast, and the per-item history shows date · who · notes · next due
The per-item 'Log service for this item...' opens the dialog with that item pre-ticked
Rigging Checks shows the Rigging Service History entries with the list name, next due, items and notes
Ship's Log row has the exact format, including Notes and Next due
My To Do has a single due_maint_<listId> item that updated to the earliest due date (01/05/2027)
Everything above was still there after reload
action_items: In BoatPrep.placePath, unfold all ancestors of the target parent as well as the parent itself, so a folded 10 opens when moving to 10.2.1
Optional: clear the MaintServiceDialog error when inputs change
critical_code_review_comments: placePath computes outlineInfo(items) inside the find callback (once per item, so O(n^2)). Compute it once.

moveToPath resolves the parent number before removing the moved branch, so moving an item from above (e.g. 7 to 10.2.1) works but the final number shifts (it showed as 9.2.1). This is reasonable, because the user types what they see, but a later typed number like 10.2.9 then fails with 'no item 10.2'. Consider a toast that shows the new number.

MaintServiceDialog ItemPicks hides top-level items with no sub-items (head && !kids.length), so an uncategorised top-level item (e.g. the legacy 'Starter' item) can't be logged from the list-level dialog.
seed_data_creation: TEST_it103 user/session/boat created with manual_it103_seed.py and removed with 'clean'. No changes to test-user-pro data (the crew check was read-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use backend/tests/manual_it103_seed.py [clean]. The ordering toggle (checkbox) and fold state are not kept across reload, so turn on ordering-toggle after each reload. Don't remove sonner toast nodes from the DOM in scripts: it crashes React (insertBefore error). After a move from above, the numbers shift, so re-read numbers before typing the next path.
